name: ionic-rfp-sweeper
description: Config-driven RFP sweeper and drafter for any Ionic operating company. Findings go to an Excel workbook and a local dashboard with assignees and action items. No Jira, no Confluence, no links to internal tools.

scripts.test: RFP_TENANTS_DIR=scripts/fixtures/tenants node scripts/test-score.mjs && RFP_TENANTS_DIR=scripts/fixtures/tenants node scripts/test-app.mjs && RFP_TENANTS_DIR=scripts/fixtures/tenants node scripts/test-analyze.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run validate && npm test
